moreErrors: {message} ({count} more errors follow; fix this one first)
indentation: Incorrect indentation: one level too deep or inconsistent. Indent with 2 spaces
isBeforeSymbol: `is` cannot be followed directly by a symbol (as in `is < 18`). Write the comparison in words, `is less than 18`, or drop `is` and use the symbol alone, `< 18`
unknownOperator: Unrecognized operator or keyword here. Write comparisons in words (`is less than` / `is at least` / `is equal to`; `is` is optional) or as bare symbols (`<` `>` `>=`). The two styles cannot be mixed: `is < 18` is a syntax error; write `is less than 18` or `< 18`
inlineIfHint: Write a one-line condition as "{if} condition {then} {return} …", or put "{return} …" on its own indented line below the condition
